thread:
Elena (PM): quick sync 20	posting a new compact grid mock for the Usage & Billing dashboard. main things: token breakdown placement, account vs team toggle behavior, and invoice CTA placement. figma: https://figma.com/s/example (mock v4)
Maya (Design): I prefer the compact rows but the token legend overlaps the sparkline at narrow widths. proposal: move legend to the right column and collapse it behind an icon for widths <720px. :thinking_face:
Ben (Frontend): right-side legend is doable but could force horizontal scroll on smaller windows. alternative: keep inline icon that opens a popover for the legend to avoid layout shifts.
Aldo (Data): also, chart stacking order matters. customers expect compute first, storage second, embeddings last. current order is ingestion-based which confuses finance teams reconciling invoices.
Sasha (Eng): we can have the backend return series in billing-priority order; frontend renders as received. reduces client-side sorting complexity.
Maya (Design): small copy nit: the toggle label reads 'Account / Workspace' elsewhere; recommend 'Account / Team' to match other console locations.
Elena (PM): good call. product question: when switching to Team scope, should charts re-scope immediately or show a notice about data latency (~10 min)?
Ben (Frontend): immediate re-scope with a subtle inline banner: "Team data may be delayed by ~10 minutes." avoids blocking flows.
Maya (Design): banner style: 12px, gray-600, info icon. add a hover tooltip linking to docs.
DesignBot: Figma comment on frame 9: "legend -> right / collapse <720px; banner style: subtle-gray-600; tooltip: 'Team metrics are updated approx. every 10 minutes.'"
a11y-bot: contrast issue: blue/green labels in the stacked area chart are 3.8:1 on small text. recommend >=4.5:1 for body text; consider patterns for colorblind users.
Maya (Design): I'll update the palette to darker label colors; keep brand blue but adjust saturation for labels.
Sasha (Eng): implement patterns as an optional accessibility toggle; also make label text semi-bold to help contrast.
Aldo (Data): token breakdown export request: customers want CSV of daily line-items. add an export action at the chart top-right that returns flat rows: token_type, model, date, tokens_consumed, cost_usd. include project_id when scoped to Team.
Ben (Frontend): CSV ok. API shape: {start, end, granularity, series[]} — Aldo confirm column names.
Aldo (Data): confirmed. include invoice_id when present.
Elena (PM): invoice CTA: current mock has a global "Download Invoice" and per-row buttons. is that redundant? thoughts?
Maya (Design): global CTA useful for account-level invoices. keep per-row CTA only when invoice_exists=true (e.g., project-specific invoices).
Ben (Frontend): per-row CTAs increase DOM nodes; lazy-render and hydrate on interaction to keep performance acceptable.
Sasha (Eng): another engineering note: the chart tooltip currently hits a realtime KV endpoint for cache hit rate; that endpoint is expensive. recommend using pre-aggregated telemetry for an estimated cached/uncached indicator.
Elena (PM): agree. use pre-agg metrics and mark wording as "estimated". log change in release notes under Billing.
Maya (Design): microcopy tweak for token tooltip: current: "tokens used by this request". propose: "Estimated tokens used (includes prompt + response). Final invoice may differ due to rounding and model surcharges." keep it concise.
a11y-bot: suggested alt text for chart export: "Stacked area chart of spend by token type over the selected date range."
Elena (PM): next steps: Maya update figma with right-legend variant and accessible color palette; Aldo post CSV spec; Ben prototype banner + legend popover; Sasha swap tooltip to pre-agg telemetry. review scheduled next Tue. :calendar:
Maya (Design): on it, will ping when mock v5 ready. :thumbsup:
Ben (Frontend): starting branch now, will link draft PR.
Sasha (Eng): prepping telemetry change and a stubbed endpoint.
Aldo (Data): CSV spec will land in #design-docs shortly.
Elena (PM): thanks all, great session.
